title: Hampton Court Palace ~$38 vs the Forbidden City ~$6 | China Travel Expert
description:
Two former royal palaces you can walk straight through today — and a price gap that's hard to believe. Hampton Court Palace near London, Henry VIII's old riverside home, charges about £30 for an adult ticket booked online in the autumn off-peak window (£33 at peak) — roughly $38. Beijing's Forbidden City, the Ming and Qing imperial palace that's now the Palace Museum, costs just ¥40 for standard admission in the winter low season from 1 November to 31 March — about $6.

That's roughly six times cheaper to walk through the far larger of the two palaces.

★ Expert Tip: Forbidden City tickets are released online seven days ahead at 20:00 Beijing time with no same-day sales at the gate — book early, and go in winter when it's ¥40 instead of the ¥60 peak price.

两座都能走进去参观的皇家宫殿：汉普顿宫成人网络票约 £30（约 $38）；故宫淡季（11/1–3/31）普通票仅 ¥40（约 $6），相差约六倍，而且故宫大得多。你会走哪一座？
